# Bid the roof and the service, not the watts.

> Price a rooftop solar install from module count, roof difficulty, panel upgrades, permits, and margin — then see dollars per watt, crew hours, and the walk-away number a cheaper per-watt quote hides.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
